meta.title: Counter offer while bidding is live: the vendor rejects
warnings: moved open_prepared to the front — every later step acts on that screen
moved open_prepared to the front — every later step acts on that screen

resolved: “The catalog has no dedicated assertion for the vendor portal's post-rejection state or rejection status; it can perform ” — switch_portal / vendor_open_event open the supplier portal as the invited QA vendor in a second browser

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ with two vendor bids directly on the buyer's Responses tab.
Ensure RFQ counter offers are visible to the buyer.
Ensure eRFX project functionality is enabled for the prepared RFQ.
Send the specified counter offer to Vendor A's normal bid.
Verify the buyer-side grid marks Vendor A's counter offer as initiated.
Switch to Vendor A's supplier-portal session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the prepared event overview where Vendor A's pending counter offer is available.
Verify the vendor portal exposes the rejection control for the pending counter offer.
Reject the buyer's pending counter offer as Vendor A.
Verify the vendor portal reports a successful rejection action.
Return to the buyer's session to inspect the bid and issue another counter offer.
Open Master QCS to verify the original bid remains active after rejection.
Assert Vendor A's displayed rate remains the original 100 rather than the rejected counter price.
Return to Responses to verify the buyer can negotiate again while bidding remains live.
Send another counter offer to confirm the buyer-side counter-offer action is available again.
Verify the new counter offer was initiated successfully.
